claim_ceiling: This map describes software/research ownership only. It does not establish model validity, airworthiness or authority.

owners.role: structure intent, requirements and unresolved assumptions
candidate-specific mission demand and mass feedback
interval dominance and visible unresolved alternatives
compare next-evaluation policies under frozen budget
quantities, units, frames, time, support, conservation and uncertainty transfer
typed request/result orchestration and explicit backend registry
solver execution, design artifacts, exact run provenance and independent replay
phase state, mass transition, bus/source/store/shaft accounting
external design release, physical test and operating approval

prohibitions: Do not introduce a second generic aircraft optimizer.
Do not place CFD/FEM/flight-dynamics authoritative calculations in the language model.
Do not assign universal scalar fidelity scores to unlike methods.
Do not promote surrogate predictions or solver convergence to physical validation.
Do not let a Symthaea proposal bypass backend allow-lists, independent checks or human release.
